adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when `cook_method` is `raw_html` (app/models/post.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` using HTML from feeds/remote pages (`SimpleRSS.parse ... i.content` in Jobs::PollFeed; `Readability::Document ... doc.content` in TopicEmbed.import_remote) without passing through Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization. The embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any unsafe markup in imported content would execute in the Discourse origin. The diff does not show any sanitization of the imported HTML before storing/rendering, making the XSS concern directly grounded in the changes.
